<Picture 1> = 金发女主肖像（黑蕾丝上衣、金项链、淡蓝绿眼）
<Video 1> = 原版三段式参考视频（地图破图 + 3D 弹出 + 实景切换，15.1 秒）
<Subject 1> = 基于 <Picture 1> 锁定的女主（全程一致性）
[1] subject_definitions

<Subject 1> is a young European woman in her early twenties with soft natural blonde wavy hair falling past her shoulders, fair porcelain skin with subtle natural blush, light blue-green eyes, soft pink lips, gentle warm smile, wearing minimal gold jewelry (small hoop earrings and a delicate gold necklace). Her facial features and overall look are strictly consistent with <Picture 1> across all shots. She has a chic, modern European aesthetic — minimal makeup, natural radiance, and an effortless traveler vibe.

[2] summary

A 15-second vertical travel vlog for Shorts/Reels/TikTok that follows <Subject 1> on a rapid European journey through three iconic destinations — Paris, Santorini, and the Swiss Alps. The video alternates between "Google Maps pin breaking through to a 3D landmark popping up" transition shots and cinematic real-scene portraits of <Subject 1> posing naturally at each location. Each real-scene segment is given a relaxed 3.5 seconds with gentle camera movement (push-in, pan, or follow), while map/3D segments are quick 1.5-second beats. The pacing is rhythmic and aspirational, with bright cheerful electronic pop music driving the cuts. The overall color palette progresses from warm rose-gold (Paris) to crisp Aegean white-blue (Santorini) to cool alpine white-blue (Switzerland).

[3] retention_analysis

Throughout the 15-second video, <Subject 1>'s facial identity, hair color, skin tone, and overall styling must remain strictly consistent with <Picture 1>. Her outfit changes per destination but her face, hair, and jewelry remain identical across all six shots. The "map pin breaking through to 3D landmark" transition motion is inherited from <Video 1> and must appear identically in shots 1, 3, and 5. The "camera descending from landmark to subject in real scene" reveal motion is also inherited from <Video 1> and must appear in shots 2, 4, and 6. The locations and outfits change, but the structural rhythm of "map → 3D → real scene" must remain exactly the same as in <Video 1>.

[4] detailed_description

[Shot 1 — 0.0s to 1.5s] Top-down close-up of a Google Maps interface showing Paris. A feminine hand enters the frame, pulls out a red pin planted on the Eiffel Tower coordinates. The map surface cracks open like shattered glass, and a detailed 3D model of the Eiffel Tower rises through the broken surface. Bright clean blue-white UI tone. Pop sound effect on pin pull, sharp glass-crack sound effect on map break.

[Shot 2 — 1.5s to 5.0s] Hard cut. The camera descends from the 3D Eiffel Tower into a real cinematic travel scene along the Seine River at golden hour. The actual Eiffel Tower stands in the background. <Subject 1> stands at the riverbank in a beige trench coat, black-and-white striped top, red beret, and gold necklace, holding a paper-wrapped baguette. She walks slowly toward the camera along the riverbank, then stops, gives a playful wink, and smiles warmly. The camera gently pushes in. Warm orange-gold lighting, the tower reflected on the Seine. Cheerful pop music continues.

[Shot 3 — 5.0s to 6.5s] Hard cut back to top-down Google Maps view, now showing Santorini, Greece. A feminine hand pulls out a red pin planted on the Santorini coordinates. The map surface cracks open, and a detailed 3D model of a whitewashed Greek church with a blue dome rises through the broken surface. Bright clean blue-white UI tone. Pin-pull and glass-crack sound effects repeat.

[Shot 4 — 6.5s to 10.0s] Hard cut. The camera descends from the 3D blue-domed church into a real cinematic travel scene on a whitewashed terrace in Oia, Santorini. <Subject 1> wears a flowing white sleeveless sundress and a straw hat, leaning against a white railing. Behind her: the iconic blue-domed churches and the deep blue Aegean Sea. She turns her head back toward the camera, hair and dress gently blown by the sea breeze, then does a small playful twirl, her dress flaring out. The camera slowly pans. Bright Mediterranean sunlight, high-contrast pure white and Aegean blue. Cheerful pop music continues.

[Shot 5 — 10.0s to 11.5s] Hard cut back to top-down Google Maps view, now showing Zermatt, Switzerland. A feminine hand pulls out a red pin planted on the Matterhorn coordinates. The map surface cracks open, and a detailed 3D model of the snow-capped Matterhorn peak rises through the broken surface. Bright clean blue-white UI tone. Pin-pull and glass-crack sound effects repeat.

[Shot 6 — 11.5s to 15.0s] Hard cut. The camera descends from the 3D Matterhorn into a real cinematic travel scene in a snow-covered alpine village. <Subject 1> wears a cream turtleneck knit sweater, dark wool skirt, camel scarf, and snow boots, walking slowly along a wooden boardwalk with light snow falling. Behind her: the majestic snow-capped Matterhorn under a clear alpine sky. The camera follows her, then she turns her head and smiles softly at the camera. Cool snow-white and icy blue tones contrast with her warm skin and clothing. Pop music fades out with a camera shutter click, ending the video at 15.0s.

[5] overall_soundscape

Throughout the video: a clean, bright, modern urban soundscape. During the map/3D transition shots (1, 3, 5): sharp digital UI sound effects — finger pin pull, glass crack, and a subtle whoosh as the 3D model rises. During the real-scene shots (2, 4, 6): light ambient atmosphere — soft Seine river breeze in Paris, gentle Aegean sea breeze in Santorini, soft wind and crunching snow underfoot in Switzerland. No dialogue, no narration, no on-screen text anywhere in the video.

[6] non_diegetic_music

A bright, upbeat, modern electronic pop instrumental BGM with a rhythmic beat pattern matching the cuts. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM, with bright synth chimes, light hand claps, and a punchy bassline. The music drives each shot transition with a downbeat. The volume stays constant through shots 1–5, then fades smoothly to silence during shot 6, ending exactly with a single crisp camera shutter click sound at the final frame (15.0s).
